sections.text_helper: Section 24.4.3 "OPAMP reset and clocks" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 729.
sections.section_content:
The OPAMP clock opamp_pclk provided by the clock controller is generated from the
PCLK1 (APB1 clock). To access the OPAMP control registers, it is necessary to set the
corresponding OPAMPxEN bit of the RCC_APB1ENR register.
The OPAMP registers can be reset through the corresponding OPAMPxRST bit of the
RCC_APB1RSTR register.
